static_traits.name: He Sen
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with friends; has one close friend providing support, but has not yet confided or sought help
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problem history; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fair organization, speech rate Not mentioned; tense emotions, negative attitude, tending toward catastrophizing, jumping to conclusions, black-and-white thinking; fairly cooperative in counseling, willing to try recording and observing thoughts

basic_info.main_problem: Anxiety and stress from slow juice-bar business make me believe my business will fail.
basic_info.core_demands: 'I just do not want to keep feeling afraid and worried. I want to feel I have some control over what happens.'; 'I do not want to panic every time business is slow. I want to feel I can handle anything without assuming the worst.'
growth_experiences: After graduating culinary school at 18, started a juice bar alone; about a month ago business turned slow, with no obvious recovery since; multiple slow days triggered persistent anxiety and worries about failure, often associating with 'losing everything'; tried new marketing strategies and promotions without significant effect; stress affects sleep and diet, attention and work performance declining; friendships strained as a result; despite having a supportive friend, still has not talked about business stress and Anxiety.

special_situations.event: Very few customers on business days (e.g., almost nobody entered the store last week)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If business is slow one day, it means the overall trend is worsening and my business will eventually fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately fixating on business data, doubling investment to try controlling the situation, while worrying constantly
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is the beginning of the business's end

special_situations.event: Still no significant improvement after implementing new marketing and promotions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If no obvious results appear soon, my efforts are utterly meaningless, I am incapable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly switching strategies, anxiously monitoring results, proving oneself with doubled effort

special_situations.event: Multiple slow-business days within a month
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One or a few slumps can represent overall failure and long-term slump
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Persistently worrying about the future, reducing communication with friends to avoid being asked or judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This means it will always be like this; I will keep being terrible

special_situations.event: Lying awake at night repeatedly thinking about business prospects due to affected sleep
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot find a solution immediately, it means I cannot control the situation, everything will get worse
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeking control through constant worrying and rehearsing worst scenarios
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have lost control; things will only get worse

core_conflict.wish: Longing for career success, stable financial security, and control over the situation
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure, financial insecurity and losing everything invested
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of failure by maintaining high vigilance and anticipating in advance
Avoiding seeking help from others to avoid exposing vulnerability and uncertainty

object_relations.self_representation: An entrepreneur oppressed by stress, anxious and inclined to bear it alone
object_relations.object_representation: Friends/others seen as people not to trouble or hard to discuss stress with

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes using reframing, reality testing and other methods to change thinking patterns or encourages multi-angle interpretation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to think 'I find it hard to change my thinking', needing reasons for being unable to change or not trying yet to ease Anxiety
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a hesitant and defensive tone, frequently using words like 'hard', 'uncertain', 'maybe', emphasizing objective difficulties, politely expressing reservations and concerns.

manifestations: Craves a sense of control over business and life
Feels a loss of control whenever business is slow
Hoping to 'no longer panic' and 'handle any situation'
Not yet talking to supportive friends about business stress and Anxiety
outcomes: Social withdrawal and support system not yet mobilized

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Even with a supportive friend, has not confided or sought help
Internalizing pressure and Anxiety and bearing them alone
When business is slow, turning energy toward self-worry and self-exhaustion rather than seeking help outwardly

positive_force: Actively seeks counseling and is willing to try observing and recording thoughts
Can, with guidance, propose other possible explanations (such as the weather, people's schedules)
Has taken concrete actions like marketing and promotions
negative_force: Cognitive patterns of catastrophizing, jumping to conclusions, overgeneralization, all-or-nothing
High Fear of failure and financial insecurity
Sleep and diet affected, leading to declining energy and focus
Interpersonal alienation and not actively seeking support
Persistently anticipating worst outcomes, impaired decision-making and work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Anxiety and catastrophizing (panic) when business is slow
antecedent: Very few customers on business days
Marketing promotions without short-term obvious effect
Thinking about future financial risks and failure possibilities
Repeatedly thinking about business when having trouble falling asleep at night
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of failure and financial insecurity, with prediction of worst outcomes and black-and-white cognitive processing
target_behavior.function: Escaping uncertainty and seeking control through worrying and rehearsing worst scenarios
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep disturbance, irregular diet, declining attention and work performance, tense relationships with friends, persistent worry about business prospects
